what: The Fancy Text Generator turns ordinary text into 36 decorative styles such as 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝑖𝑡𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑐, 𝓈𝒸𝓇𝒾𝓅𝓉, 𝔤𝔬𝔱𝔥𝔦𝔠, ⓑⓤⓑⓑⓛⓔ, ꜱᴍᴀʟʟ ᴄᴀᴘꜱ and uʍop ǝpısdn. Each style has a Copy button.

It is popular for social media bios, usernames, gaming names, posts and messages where you cannot choose a font. The styles are built from real Unicode characters, so they keep their look wherever you paste them.
Everything happens on your device. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.
uses: Make your name or tagline stand out on Instagram, TikTok or X.
Create a distinctive nickname or server title.
Use bold or sans-serif bold to make a heading in places that do not allow formatting, such as LinkedIn or Facebook posts.
Add flair to a birthday message or event announcement.
Try out playful text quickly without installing fonts.
tutorial: Type or paste into Your text. Until you type, a sample (Hello World 123) is shown so you can browse the styles.
Scroll down the list. Each row shows the style name and your text in that style. Long text wraps and can be scrolled inside its row.
Type a word like bold, script or bubble into Filter styles to show only matching styles.
Tap Copy next to the style you want. The button changes to Copied! when your text is on the clipboard.
Paste it where you need it. If you see boxes or question marks there, that app or font does not support the style; choose another.
features: Bold, italic, bold italic, script, bold script, fraktur, bold fraktur, double-struck, four sans-serif styles, monospace, bubble, dark bubble, squared, dark squared, parenthesized, fullwidth, small caps, superscript, subscript, upside down, reversed, seven line and mark styles, wide spacing and two decorations.

Uses the right Letterlike Symbols for the letters Unicode placed there first, such as script ℬ ℰ ℱ ℋ ℐ ℒ ℳ ℛ ℯ ℊ ℴ, fraktur ℭ ℌ ℑ ℜ ℨ and double-struck ℂ ℍ ℕ ℙ ℚ ℝ ℤ, so no letter turns into an empty box.
Numbers are styled too in bold, double-struck, sans-serif, monospace, bubble and other styles that have them.
Every style has its own Copy button.
Multi-line text and emoji pass through unchanged.

example.title: Worked example: a stylish Instagram bio
example.text: Type "Coffee lover | Photographer". The Script style gives 𝒞ℴ𝒻𝒻ℯℯ 𝓁ℴ𝓋ℯ𝓇 | 𝒫𝒽ℴ𝓉ℴℊ𝓇𝒶𝓅𝒽ℯ𝓇, where o, e and g come from the Letterlike Symbols block. Tap Copy on that row, open Instagram, edit your bio and paste. Check the preview on your phone: if any letter shows as a box, try Bold script instead.

tips: Use fancy text for a name or a short heading, not whole paragraphs, so it stays readable.
Bold and sans-serif bold are the most widely supported styles.
Screen readers may spell out or skip fancy letters, so keep key information in plain text.
Search engines and in-app search may not match fancy letters to normal words, so do not style words people search for.
Upside down text is reversed so it reads correctly when the phone is turned around.
problems: I see boxes or question marks
The app or font where you pasted does not include those characters. Choose a more common style like Bold or Italic.
Some letters look different from the rest
In script, fraktur and double-struck, a few letters come from an older Unicode block and some fonts draw them slightly differently. This is correct Unicode.
Numbers or symbols did not change
Unicode has no styled versions of them in that style, so they are left as they are.
Some sites only allow plain letters and numbers in usernames. Use fancy text in your display name or bio instead.
